verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can run Airweave themselves: clone the GitHub repo, run ./start.sh on macOS, Linux or WSL, and open the dashboard at localhost:8080. A community comment from another vendor's founder places it in the open-source AI space. The documentation frames this as a local deployment, so production readiness is unclear. Missing for 10: production-grade self-hosting guidance (e.g., Kubernetes/cloud deployment, scaling, configuration docs), clarity on whether self-hosted parity matches the hosted service, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
